properties.originalText:
ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY CITIZENS OF THE 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION, OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) 
ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO 
ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF POLAND EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, SAR 
AND LEASED AIRCRAFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLIGHTS WITH THE PERMISSION OF 
THE APPROPRIATE POLISH AUTHORITIES AND IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING 
OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT.
THE PERMISSION IS AVAILABLE FROM CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF 
POLAND IN WRITING VIA EMAIL TO: CAAPL(AT)ULC.GOV.PL.
